title: Stock Market News: Latest Stock News Today, Stock Market LIVE, Stock Market Headline Updates | Mint

knownGaps.why: Genuine limitation. The page spans more orders of magnitude than one decimal grid can serve, so no single shape fits both ends. Same family as openai-pricing and aws-s3-pricing. Indian market copy quotes a share price beside a figure in crore.

fiatRemainingWhy: 1 remaining, deliberate: "₹ 3999" is refused as a possible concatenation, because four unbroken digits after a symbol is the signature of a price glued together out of separate elements ($49 + 99 reading as $4999). Styled prices routinely put a space there too, so the space cannot be used to tell the two apart. A hundredfold error is worse than a gap.
